name: Blood
identity: Choose when to sacrifice a health card for Ichor. Bleed and Blood Mark keep pressure on the enemy, while a successful attack can recover a card lost to earlier damage.
loop: Mark an enemy to earn Ichor from damage → use Ichor to prepare recovery on a successful attack → apply Bleed for steady pressure → reserve Clot for a dangerous Ongoing Effects.
statuses: The first time each round you sacrifice one of your cards, gain 2 Ichor. Before your Offensive attack, you may spend 2 Ichor. If that attack makes the enemy lose a health card, return one of your cards previously lost to damage to your discard pile. Use this recovery once per round. Sacrificed cards cannot be recovered. Keep unused Ichor.
During Ongoing Effects, this enemy takes 1 damage per Bleed, then remove 1 Bleed. No die is rolled.

When damage makes this enemy lose at least one health card, remove 1 Blood Mark. The player who placed it gains 1 Ichor. Use only one Mark for damage dealt together, regardless of how many cards are lost. A sacrifice does not trigger Blood Mark. Remove unused Marks at the end of the following round.

When normal Poison or Bleed would damage you during Ongoing Effects, spend 1 Clot to prevent all damage from one of those statuses for that Ongoing Effects. Poison still rolls and can clear normally; Bleed still loses one stack. Use Clot once per round. Keep unused Clot. Clot does not stop Volatile Poison.
abilities: 4 / 5 / 6 damage and apply 1 Blood Mark to that enemy after damage is dealt. This new Mark does not count that same damage.
Gain 2 Ichor and 1 Clot. No health payment.
Deal 4 damage and apply 1 Bleed. Optionally spend 1 Ichor when choosing this ability to apply one additional Bleed.
Deal 6 damage. When choosing this ability, you may spend 1 Ichor to apply 1 Bleed and gain 1 Clot after the attack. You may separately use Ichor’s recovery rule if you can spend its 2 Ichor cost.
Each Fang prevents 1; each Vein gains 1 Ichor; any Chalice gains 1 Clot.
Fang: prevent 2. Vein: prevent 3. Chalice: prevent 2 and apply 1 Blood Mark to the attacker.
cards: Apply 1 Blood Mark to one enemy.
Sacrifice one additional card from your hand or discard pile, then draw 1. You must keep at least one health card after paying. Your first sacrifice each round earns 2 Ichor.
Spend up to 2 Ichor; add 2 damage each to your attack.
Spend 1 Ichor; apply 1 Bleed and 1 Blood Mark to one enemy.
Spend 2 Ichor; gain 1 Energy. Once per round.
Spend 2 Ichor to return one of your cards previously lost to damage to your discard pile. Unlike Ichor’s attack reward, this does not require you to damage an enemy.
Spend 1 enemy Bleed; add 2 damage to your attack against that enemy.
Prevent 2 from one attack, card or status targeting you.

Sacrifice one additional card from your hand or discard pile to prevent 4 damage from one attack, card or status. Choose a card that the incoming damage would not already remove. You must keep at least one health card after paying. The sacrificed card cannot be recovered.

Spend 2 Ichor. Take 1 less damage from one enemy attack, card or status; that enemy takes that 1 damage instead. They may prevent it but do not roll another Defensive ability. The same damage cannot be redirected again.
Set one of your combat dice that is not Frostbound to face 1 or 4; the final dice must allow the chosen ability.
Reroll one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card. Use the new number for that effect; Curse or Boon can still activate on either roll if it hits a marked face.
Spend 1 Ichor; remove 1 negative status stack from yourself.
Remove 1 Bleed from yourself; gain 1 Clot. Requires Bleed.
Spend 1 Ichor; stop 1 negative status stack an enemy is about to apply to you.
Choose one of your health cards revealed by incoming damage. If that damage removes the card, gain 1 Ichor and 1 Clot afterward.
Upgrade once per battle: the first Blood Mark you consume each round grants 2 Ichor instead of 1.
Spend 3 Ichor to prevent 4 damage from one attack, card or status. If that damage still removes a health card, return one of your cards lost to earlier damage to your discard pile afterward.
Spend 3 Ichor to return two of your cards previously lost to damage to your discard pile. Use once per battle, during your Offensive planning. You cannot play it after defeat.
pairs: Poison damage can consume Blood Mark for Ichor, setting up Blood’s next attack-heal payment. Clot also offers one round of protection against normal Poison on the mixed creature, without cleansing it.
Sacrifice earns Ichor once per round and can create a Corpse for Remnant. The sacrificed card stays removed; Grave’s recovery must choose a different card previously lost to damage.

Sanguine Pact sacrifices a card to prevent attack damage. That can earn Ichor from the sacrifice and Resolve from preventing at least 2. Armor protects against later attacks but cannot reduce sacrifice costs.
Bleed applying to a Spored enemy earns Growth. Growth pays for protection and recovery while Blood spends Ichor on conditional recovery. Neither type can recover cards paid as sacrifices.
example: An enemy with Blood Mark loses a card to Poison. You gain 1 Ichor. Add one saved Ichor and spend both before attacking. If the attack removes an enemy health card, recover a card you lost to earlier damage. A fully blocked attack gives no recovery.
counter: Block an Ichor-funded attack to deny its recovery after the cost is paid. Remove Blood Mark to cut off safe Ichor generation. Clot handles normal Poison or Bleed for one round; other damage still gets through.
balance: The existing Bleed rule stays unchanged: three stacks deal 3, then 2, then 1 damage over successive Ongoing Effects, with no dice. Ichor recovery requires both payment and a damaging attack. Clot does not remove the affliction and does not protect against Volatile Poison.
combos: Blood Seal → Pin the Wound → Ichor
Apply a Mark before Bleed deals damage. One health-card loss consumes one Mark and earns Ichor; several lost cards do not multiply that reward.
A sacrifice earns two Ichor once per round, but that sacrificed card cannot be recovered. Spend Ichor to recover an earlier damage loss if your attack lands; keep Clot for enemy Poison or Bleed.

Ichor.job: Trade a health payment for conditional recovery and Blood techniques.
Ichor.example: Spend Ichor before attacking. If the enemy blocks all damage, you paid the Ichor but recover no card.

Bleed.job: Deal damage that declines one stack at a time.
Bleed.example: With three Bleed, you take 3 damage and keep two stacks. If nothing changes, later rounds deal 2, then 1.

Blood Mark.job: Let any damaging attack or status supply Ichor.
Blood Mark.example: Poison makes a marked enemy lose two cards. Remove one Blood Mark and gain one Ichor, not two.

Clot.job: Stop one round of a specific affliction without cleansing it.
Clot.example: With both Poison and Bleed, spend Clot to stop the Bleed damage. Poison still deals its normal damage.
